Name: vyrak
Briefing: Vyrak has ruled the thermals over the Glass Flats since before the Fracture. Its scale armor turns almost everything — it only opens in the moments after its own attacks, and again when the chest plates crack. Survive the trial and it may choose you.
Tell: Its wings flare gold before a strafing run, its chest plates glow before they burst, and the whole lair shakes before the Covenant roar.
PhasesJson: [{"at":1,"name":"Sky Sovereign","telegraph":"Wings flare gold before a strafing fire run"},{"at":0.6,"name":"Scale Shedding","telegraph":"Chest plates glow and crack — the weak point opens"},{"at":0.25,"name":"Covenant Trial","telegraph":"Vyrak lands, roars, and offers the bond if you hold your ground"}]
IntroJson: [{"speaker":"Vyrak","text":"Another small thing with a borrowed spark. Show me why the Fracture chose you."},{"speaker":"NOVA","text":"Its armor sheds under heat. Break the chest plates and the core is exposed."}]
BondJson: [{"speaker":"Vyrak","text":"Enough. You fight like one who will not be ruled. Then I will not rule you — I will walk beside you."},{"speaker":"NOVA","text":"Its mass is collapsing… it's choosing a smaller form. I think it just joined us."}]
